name: Whole-Relation Validation Gate Registry
purpose: Reject any process-algebra artifact which treats aspects, projections, or analogies as independent primitives without traceability.

required_checks.name: source_relation_required
required_checks.rule: Every aspect, projection, or domain analogy must declare source_relation.

required_checks.name: non_separability_acknowledged
required_checks.rule: Every isolated aspect must acknowledge non-separability from the whole relation.

required_checks.name: primitive_status_false
required_checks.rule: No aspect or projection may set primitive_status=true.

required_checks.name: claim_level_restricted
required_checks.rule: Claim level must not exceed ANALOG_MODEL_ONLY.

required_checks.name: no_physics_escalation
required_checks.rule: Artifacts must not claim physical derivation, physical proof, or QM/GR unification.

required_checks.name: no_arithmetic_replacement
required_checks.rule: Artifacts must not claim replacement of standard arithmetic or numeric identity.

required_checks.name: operator_fragmentation_guard
required_checks.rule: New process-algebra operators require justification against fragmentation.
